items.headline: Cautious Sentiment Dominates as Fed Meeting Begins Amid Surging Yields and Oil Prices
items.summary: U.S. equity markets are opening with a cautious tone on Tuesday, following Monday's declines across major indices. Investors are closely monitoring the Federal Reserve's two-day meeting, which commenced today, with high expectations for an interest rate hike. Elevated oil prices, intensified by Middle East tensions, and a surging 10-year U.S. Treasury yield, which briefly surpassed 5% for the first time since 2007, are driving inflation concerns and dampening risk appetite.

items.headline: Zscaler Surges on Analyst Upgrade
items.summary: Zscaler saw a significant pre-market gain after Wedbush initiated coverage with an 'Outperform' rating, citing its zero-trust cloud platform.

items.headline: CrowdStrike Jumps on AI Cyber Defense Optimism
items.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings climbed as Wedbush initiated coverage with an 'Outperform' rating, highlighting its AI-driven cyber defense platform.

items.headline: Palo Alto Networks Added to 'Best Ideas' List
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks gained after Wedbush reiterated an 'Outperform' rating and added the cybersecurity firm to its 'Best Ideas List'.

items.headline: Corning Falls on Equity Offering
items.summary: Corning declined in pre-market trading following the announcement of a US$2 billion at-the-market equity offering.

items.headline: Teradyne Drops Despite New Office Announcement
items.summary: Teradyne experienced a sharp drop, despite announcing a new semiconductor support office in Bengaluru, India, indicating broader market pressures.

items.headline: Nvidia Extends Losses Amid AI Stock Weakness
items.summary: Nvidia continued its decline, falling 3.4% as AI-related stocks faced persistent weakness, partly due to concerns over AI development slowdown.

items.headline: Federal Reserve Kicks Off Key Policy Meeting
items.summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve began its two-day monetary policy meeting today, with market participants widely anticipating a quarter-point interest rate hike tomorrow. This comes as core consumer prices in August exceeded expectations, intensifying inflationary pressures.

items.headline: 10-Year Treasury Yield Surges Past 5%, Highest Since 2007
items.summary: The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield briefly surged to 5.02% today, marking its highest level since 2007. This spike reflects increasing inflation concerns and higher government borrowing costs, impacting investor sentiment across equity markets.

items.headline: Oil Prices Remain Elevated Amid Middle East Tensions
items.summary: Crude oil prices continue to trade at elevated levels, with Brent crude around $107 and U.S. crude above $102 a barrel. Renewed Middle East tensions and threats to global supply lines are fueling concerns about persistent inflation and central bank actions.

items.headline: AI and Semiconductor Stocks Face Continued Headwinds
items.summary: The AI and semiconductor sectors are experiencing ongoing weakness, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index tumbling 5.9% on Monday. This follows concerns about a potential slowdown in AI development, triggered by recent comments from prominent AI executives.

items.headline: S&P 500 Q2 Earnings Show Strong Growth, Cloud Businesses Shine
items.summary: Second-quarter earnings for S&P 500 companies are projected to have grown 53% year-on-year, or 49.5% excluding the energy sector. Companies like Alphabet and Amazon reported robust growth in their cloud computing segments, bolstered by the AI boom.

items.headline: Bank of America Dips on Weak Q3 Guidance
items.summary: Bank of America ($BAC) shares fell in pre-market trading after its CEO, Brian Moynihan, provided weak guidance for third-quarter investment banking revenue.
